description: L1 smoke baseline. Top-level = REAL baseline derived from the 2026-11-22 G6 full run, filtered to the 50 smoke task ids. `byServer` / `serverSets` = immutable per-server snapshots for real runs that skip Figma (20 vs 10 tasks per server). `fake` section = deterministic offline reference used only by fake-dry-run CI mode (all-pass wiring check). This file is the ONLY baseline source at run time; the runner must never derive a baseline from explore/results/* (that is the current run output in real mode).
source: One-time offline computation from explore/results/metrics.json + explore/results/anomalies.json of G6 run 6b4254c / run-1795368949291-1d86ee2a (228 tasks, hy4-flash-free), filtered to explore/tasks-smoke.json ids; snapshot frozen into this file on 2026-11-23. Completion uses the anomaly-based proxy (no runner_error / max_turns_exceeded), not the raw `finished` boolean (see docs/eval/L1-SMOKE.md). Not recomputed at run time.
computedFrom: explore/results/metrics.json + explore/results/anomalies.json (2026-11-22 G6 full run; one-time snapshot, see docs/eval/l1-real-2026-11-22.md)

byServer._note: Frozen per-server L1 smoke metrics from the same G6 run (10 smoke tasks each). Keys are server names; `_note` is metadata, not a server. Used by deriveBaselineForServers() to build a like-for-like baseline for real runs that skip one or more servers.

serverSets._note: Precomputed exact 40-task snapshot (github/notion/linear/vercel, Figma skipped) from the same G6 run; preferred over averaging p95 across byServer when this exact server set is used. Keys are comma-separated sorted server lists.

fake.source: deterministic simulation (scripts/run-l1-smoke.mjs fakeMetrics). Not a gateway measurement; wiring check only.
